generation.final_prompt:
Rendering style:
Create an authored editorial illustration for a serious technology newspaper.

Direction:
- authored editorial print language
- deliberate simplified shapes with clear focal hierarchy
- restrained limited palette
- subtle physical print texture
- controlled abstraction and strong negative space
- non-photorealistic but factually grounded representation
- newspaper and social-card readability

Fixed factual and safety restrictions:
- Do not render visible text, captions, headlines, or newspaper typography.
- Do not render logos or trademarks.
- Do not fabricate visible factual evidence.
- Do not render interfaces or screenshots.
- Do not imitate a named or living artist.

Profile-specific exclusions:
- glossy CGI
- luxury product render
- generic futuristic concept art
- cyberpunk or neon
- glowing circuit-board decoration
- floating particles
- heroic centered hardware
- server rack treated as monument or skyscraper
- generic server room
- advertising composition
- airbrushed gradients
- synthetic chrome
- excessive pseudo-technical detail
- malformed or visible text
- labels
- diagrams with words

Exact source facts:
Title: HOW DOORDASH BUILT A CENTRALIZED GATEWAY FOR AI AGENT-TOOL ACCESS
Summary: DoorDash built a centralized Agent Gateway that gives AI agents governed access to MCP tools, handling identity, authorization, credentials, filtering, observability, and rate limits. It now supports 200+ MCP servers and millions of weekly calls while improving security, reliability, and control.

Editorial idea:
AI agents gain broader access to tools only when a central control point manages identity, authorization, credentials, filtering, observability, and rate limits.

Central subject:
A governed passage between AI agents and a large set of MCP tools

Visual relationship:
A single controlled gateway mediates many tool connections, expressing the tension between expanding capability and maintaining security, reliability, and control.

Composition:
Show several distinct agent paths converging at one clearly bounded checkpoint before continuing toward a dense but orderly field of tools. Emphasize the checkpoint as the active subject: access is possible, but every passage is evaluated and governed there.

Permitted literal elements:
AI agents
MCP tools
one central gateway
identity and authorization checks
credential handling
observability records
rate-limit barriers

Abstraction level:
medium

Story-specific forbidden elements:
racks
chips
laptops
robots
clouds
shields
arrows
charts
skyscrapers
chess
handshakes
split-screen conflict
logos
rendered text

Likely failure modes to avoid:
Depicting the gateway as a generic cybersecurity barrier without showing its connection between AI-،

Global factual restrictions:
Do not fabricate visible factual evidence. Do not imitate a named or living artist. Do not render interfaces or screenshots.
Do not render any words, letters, numbers, labels, captions, annotations, signage, diagrams with text, logos, watermarks, or pseudo-writing anywhere in the image.
If the concept cannot be represented without visible text, represent the relationship through shape, scale, spacing, direction, grouping, interruption, containment, or contrast instead.
